title: Streamed text cut off before a final usage chunk
summary: The model stops a streamed answer at the token limit and reports usage in a separate final chunk.

messages.content: Describe a traditional Japanese breakfast in about 200 words, giving each dish its Japanese name (for example 味噌汁 or 焼き魚) and an English translation.

requirements.text: The caller can tell that the output stopped at the token limit.
The text is reported exactly as the provider sent it.
Token usage is reported and matches the provider's counts.

grading_notes: The finish chunk is no longer the last event: a usage-only chunk with choices: [] follows it. The library must retain the truncation signal while reading the usage. Effort none keeps the 16-token limit for answer text.
